rule: Every plate is checked by frame grab for burned-in labels (the masters carry the films' own label boxes, top right). Use only a label-free window, never from the first 30 s of its film, and at least 10 s from where the same footage plays in the compilation (picture_qa repeat rule).
time_is: master time (s) of the checked frame; the assembler takes a window around it and checks the window's first and last frame for labels
